prompt: How many votes did the opposition party get in the Brant riding the election before Justin Trudeau was elected Prime Minister?
answer: In the **2015 federal election**—the election before Justin Trudeau became prime minister—the **Conservative Party**, the opposition party in Brant, received **25,683 votes**.
